description: Values mub6_manifold_integration.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

coverage_closure_certified.reason: verify_full_unified_coverage sets closure_certified without a cover certificate; finitely many samples cannot certify a continuous region. It makes moduli_covering_closure false, so mub_verify_all stops at step 3.2, and the committed mub_target_b3_manifold_integration_receipt.json (no producer) reports closure true.
